egin{claim} \end{claim}[Mixed second partials vanish] ↗ lem:l-length-second-variation-formula

\[ rac{\partial }{\partial v} rac{\partial }{\partial w}{\mathcal L}(\mu )|_{u=v=0}= rac{\partial }{\partial w} rac{\partial }{\partial v}{\mathcal L}(\mu )|_{v=w=0}=0. \] \end{claim}
Proof

\sketch Of course, the second partial derivatives are equal. According to Lemma lem:l-length-second-variation-formula we have

\[ rac{\partial }{\partial v} rac{\partial }{\partial w}{\mathcal L}(\mu )|_{v=w=0} =2\sqrt{ ar au } \widetilde Y'( ar au )\langle \widetilde W( ar au ),X( ar au ) angle -\int _{ au _1}^{ ar au }2\sqrt{ au }\langle \Jac (\widetilde Y'),W angle d au . \]

Since $W( ar au )=0$ and since $ abla _{\widetilde Y'}(\widetilde W)= abla _W(\widetilde Y')$, the boundary term vanishes. The integral vanishes since $\widetilde Y'$ is an ${\mathcal L}$-Jacobi field.
